title: Reversa Pricing Profile
description: Billing profile generated by the reversa-pricing-profile agent, consumed by size, estimate and product.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 = 1.0, v1.1 added tax fields, v1.2 added mode, region and field origin.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the profile's creation or last regeneration.

mode.description: experienced = the user informed the values (I can inform); beginner = the hourly rate was researched and the other fields received default values (research).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the operation country.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the local currency.

city.description: City of operation informed by the user in beginner mode.

state.description: State or province of operation informed by the user in beginner mode.

region.description: Region used by the hourly rate research. null in experienced mode or when the user skipped it.

hourly_rate.description: Net hourly rate in local currency.

hourly_rate_mode.description: direct = user informed the value; derived = calculated from monthly_target_income and billable_hours_per_month; researched = chosen inside the reversa-pricing-research range and confirmed by the user.

monthly_target_income.description: Desired net monthly income in local currency. Required when hourly_rate_mode = derived, null otherwise.

billable_hours_per_month.description: Estimated billable hours per month. Required when hourly_rate_mode = derived, null otherwise.

margin_percent.description: Project markup over direct cost, in percent. The historical field name remains margin_percent for compatibility.

tax_regime.description: Canonical key of the tax regime documented in references/tax-regimes.md, or 'other'.

tax_factor.description: Approximate tax factor associated with the regime. Applied by the Pricer over the direct cost.

tax_factor_kind.description: Factor type: approximate effective reserve, simplified statutory proxy, or tax not computed.

tax_factor_source.description: Public source or internal catalog that justifies the approximate factor.

includes_vat.description: Indicates whether the factor combines income tax / contribution with VAT/IVA/ISS highlighted.

vat_pass_through_warning.description: Indicates whether the estimate must warn that part of the tax may be passed through to the client and not reduce margin.

tax_regime_confidence.description: high = user chose explicitly; low = fallback suggestion or 'other'.

client_profile.description: Can be empty when the user chooses to skip this question or in beginner mode.

billing_currency.description: Currency in which the user charges the client when different from currency. null when charging in local currency.

exchange_rate_to_local.description: Manual exchange rate: how many units of currency equal 1 unit of billing_currency. null when not charging in foreign currency.

research_ref.description: Path of _pricing/research/hourly_rate.json when the hourly rate was researched. null otherwise.

field_origins.description: Origin of each sensitive field of the profile: typed by the user, researched by the research agent or default from the agent.

origin.description: typed = informed by the user; researched = coming from reversa-pricing-research and confirmed; default = default value of the agent accepted without change.

source.description: Source of the value: path of the research plus source names, or name of the applied default. null when typed.

researched_at.description: Research access date (sources[0].accessed_at of the research, YYYY-MM-DD). null when not researched.
